verdict.rationale: cubic's privacy docs state that its AI model providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) contractually commit not to train on customer code or metadata. Organizations can also ask to block AI features entirely for their workspace. However, the guarantee covers only third-party providers, and nothing states whether cubic itself trains its own review models on customer code. Missing for 10: explicit first-party no-training commitment from cubic, a self-serve training opt-out control rather than a request-based block, independent or hands-on verification.
